sections.title: Rates
sections.text: US 10-year 4.99% (-18 bp in a month), 2-year 4.70% (-11 bp); 2s10s curve +29 bp (-7 bp in a month). Falling yields ease funding costs and support commodity investment flows. T-bill yield 3.99% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 102.16 (+0.9% in a month, +3.9% YTD). USD/BRL 5.348 (+3.1% in a month): a weaker real encourages Brazilian farmer selling of soybeans, corn, sugar, coffee and cotton, pressuring world prices. USD/CNY 6.655 (-0.9%); USD/MXN 18.60 (+4.8%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 +0.7% in a month (+13.0% YTD); VIX 17.4. Neutral risk backdrop.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 102.84 $/bbl (+15.5% in a month), Brent 111.69, ULSD 4.670 $/gal (+6.9%), natural gas 3.02 (-12.4%). Higher crude lifts biofuel margins (soybean oil, corn for ethanol) and synthetic-fibre costs (supports cotton), but raises diesel, drying and freight costs. Natural gas drives nitrogen fertilizer costs for next year's corn.

us_econ: Inflation: CPI 3.7% y/y (2026-09), core 2.6%; core 3-month annualized 3.4%; core PCE 3.0%. Jobs: payrolls +29k in 2026-09 (3-month average +51k), unemployment 4.2% (+0.1), wages 3.0% y/y. Growth: real GDP 2.2% annualized in 2026-Q2, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.70% (+0.82 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.35%, real 10-year 2.64%. Farm prices (PPI farm products) +1.5% y/y; food-at-home CPI +1.8% y/y. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
